content.value_statement: Network teams need fast visibility into UniFi site and device health. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured checks and diagnostics.
actual_capabilities: List configured UniFi sites for review.
Check site health and identify degraded status.
List devices within a UniFi site.
Review device statistics such as CPU, memory, and uptime.
Check network system information and metrics.
limitations: Requires configured UniFi network tools and valid access.
Only reports data available through the connected tools.
Does not change device settings or repair issues automatically.
Does not replace vendor monitoring or alerting systems.

use_cases.title: Check Site Health
use_cases.description: Review all UniFi sites and find locations with degraded health.

use_cases.title: Investigate Device Problems
use_cases.description: Find offline or underperforming devices and review key performance metrics.

use_cases.title: Compare Managed Networks
use_cases.description: Summarize health and device status across several customer sites.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Health Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the health of all UniFi sites and summarize any degraded status.

prompt_templates.title: Find Device Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: List offline or underperforming devices for the selected site, then group issues by severity.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Site Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare site health across all sites and highlight patterns in device status, CPU, memory, and uptime.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Slow Connectivity
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full troubleshooting workflow for slow connectivity in the selected site. Start with site health, inspect devices, review system information, and produce recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: What is the health status of all my sites?
output_examples.output: A site-by-site health summary with status labels, degraded locations, and the next checks to run.

output_examples.input: Which devices are offline or using high CPU?
output_examples.output: A prioritized device list with offline status, high resource usage, uptime context, and troubleshooting recommendations.

output_examples.input: Generate a diagnostic report for slow connectivity.
output_examples.output: A structured report covering site health, device metrics, likely causes, and practical next actions.

best_practices: Start with site health before inspecting individual devices.
Correlate device statistics with reported user issues.
Document repeated patterns for trend analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not assume one high metric proves root cause.
Do not skip site health when troubleshooting a device.
Do not use stale metrics for incident decisions.

faq.question: What networks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is designed for UniFi network infrastructure exposed through the configured tools.

faq.question: Does it change network settings?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on monitoring, diagnostics, and reporting.

faq.question: Can it monitor multiple sites?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list sites and compare health across the available UniFi infrastructure.

faq.question: What device metrics can it review?
faq.answer: It can review available status and performance metrics, including CPU, memory, and uptime.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it replace production monitoring?
faq.answer: No. Use it for assisted diagnostics alongside existing monitoring and alerting systems.
